system.description:
You manifest acidic chakra in the form of barbed wires, enough to fill a 20-foot cube originating from you. For the duration, creatures, excluding you, who would begin their turn or enter for the first time on their turn, the affected area, they take 7 acid damage and an additional 7 acid damage for every 5 feet they would move through the affected area.

A creature cannot take damage from the same space more than once per round.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the size of the affected area by 5 feet.
